outcome.description: Whether this lane completed its bounded work. Use needs_human only when implementation cannot safely finish without information or a decision that only a person can provide; a question that can travel to audit does not change a completed outcome.

human_questions.description: Questions that prevent this lane from completing. Empty when outcome is completed. Squadron decides who receives them and where work resumes.

implemented.description: Whether a change was implemented. False when the disposition is unsupported, when a blocking question stopped the work, or when adopting an existing PR rather than writing one.

adopted_existing_pr.description: True when this session took ownership of a fix PR a terminated session had opened, rather than writing a fix. Adoption means reading the diff, confirming it matches the briefed mechanism, and holding the lane so the audit stage has a session to route corrections to -- never re-implementing, reverting, widening, or opening a second PR.

pr_url.description: The PR URL, or empty if none was opened.

branch.description: Branch the change is on — later stages push to this same branch.

head_sha.description: Head SHA of the pushed branch, for the ratevariant plan/run coupling.

files_changed.description: Paths changed. Never tests/ratevariant-cases/** — those belong to the case-authoring stage.

roots_touched.description: Execution roots the change alters, including mirrored non-SSUTA cart/ETL paths.

mirrored_paths_checked.description: Whether the non-SSUTA cart (inline in spTransactionLookup_nonssuta) and ETL (fnGetTaxRatesforTx_nonssuta) counterparts were checked for drift.

diagnosis_disagreement.description: If implementing contradicted the investigation's diagnosis, what the code showed. Empty otherwise. Do not silently re-diagnose.

fix_summary.description: At most 150 words: what changed and the behavior it produces.
